709c798e303e31fe.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث فندق ديار الهدى الفندقية عن مندوب مشتريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة عمليات الشراء المختلفة، بدءًا من الشراء المباشر وصولاً إلى متابعة المناقصات واستلام المواد. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال المشتريات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طلبات الشراء الواردة من الجهات المعنية وتدقيقها لضمان توافقها مع اللوائح التنظيمية للمشتريات. تنفيذ عمليات الشراء المباشر للمواد والسلع المختلفة وفقًا للوائح والإجراءات المعتمدة. تجهيز وثائق المناقصات وتوزيعها، وجمع عروض التوريد، وتشكيل فرق لدراسة العروض ومتابعتها. تدقيق نتائج دراسة العروض وإرساء طلبات الشراء على العرض الأنسب بناءً على اللوائح والتنظيمات المعمول بها. متابعة استلام المشتريات والتأكد من مطابقة الكميات والمواصفات المطلوبة. تدقيق المطالبات المالية المتعلقة بالمشتريات لضمان دقتها وامتثالها للإجراءات. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، بالإضافة إلى توثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المشتريات. معرفة جيدة بلوائح وإجراءات المشتريات. القدرة على تدقيق المستندات المالية والفنية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة والقدرة على إعداد التقارير. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل المندوب ضمن فريق متخصص في إدارة المشتريات لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق فندق ديار الهدى الفندقية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

70a5758025032c34.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تودو أوبس عن أخصائي مبيعات نظم تقنية المعلومات والاتصالات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة فرص مبيعات حلول Odoo وتخطيط موارد المؤسسات (ERP)، مع التركيز على فهم احتياجات العملاء وتقديم الحلول المناسبة لهم. يتضمن الدور تقديم العروض التوضيحية والتجارية، ومتابعة المفاوضات وإغلاق الصفقات، وتطوير الحسابات بالتنسيق مع فريق التنفيذ. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تأهيل فرص المبيعات وجمع احتياجات العملاء وتوثيقها بدقة. تقديم عروض توضيحية لحلول Odoo وشرح مدى ملاءمتها لعمليات العميل. إعداد نطاق وعروض تجارية تفصيلية تميز بين التراخيص وخدمات التنفيذ والدعم، مع الالتزام بسياسة التسعير وبعد مراجعة تقدير التنفيذ. متابعة العملاء، والتفاوض، وإغلاق الصفقات، وتحديث سجل الفرص والخطوات التالية بشكل مستمر. تسليم الاتفاقيات المبرمة لفريق التنفيذ ومتابعة فرص التوسع وتطوير الحسابات القائمة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. خبرة في استخدام Odoo أو حلول تخطيط موارد المؤسسات (ERP) وتطبيقات الأعمال ذات الصلة. القدرة على فهم احتياجات العملاء وربطها بالحلول التقنية المناسبة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على التفاوض وإغلاق الصفقات بفعالية. مهارات تنظيمية قوية والقدرة على إدارة الفرص المتعددة. العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل أخصائي المبيعات ضمن فريق مبيعات متخصص، ويتعاون بشكل وثيق مع فريق التنفيذ لضمان تقديم أفضل الحلول للعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

7006e5993d0c5d59.description: About the Role TAWANTECH is seeking a Product & Technical Expert (PTE) for a full-time position focused on Agentic AI in Contact Center. This role involves leading and managing the product and technical aspects of a project spanning virtual AI bots/conversational IVR, agent-assist systems, and interaction analytics. The PTE will oversee the project from requirements definition and vendor selection through solution design, integration, AI governance, and delivery, while also building internal capabilities through knowledge transfer. Key Responsibilities Manage and refine business and technical requirements across virtual AI bot/conversational IVR, agent-assist, and interaction analytics components, maintaining requirements and compliance matrices. Develop and maintain use-cases and an intent-prioritization backlog (Tier 1 automated, Tier 2 AI-assisted, Tier 3 human), translating call-driver data into an automation roadmap. Define Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and success/acceptance criteria for project deliverables. Support RFP issuance, conduct technical evaluations of bidders, lead proofs-of-concept (including Saudi-dialect quality testing), and provide sourcing recommendations. Technically manage the implementation partner, including scope, statement of work, deliverables, and quality assurance. Oversee conversational and agentic design, including open intent capture, dialog flows, prompts, tone/persona, escalation triggers, and warm-handoff behavior. Manage the design of the RAG grounding approach, knowledge-base structure, and guardrail configuration. Define target architecture and external/internal integration design across core banking (T24), CRM (MS Dynamics), Cortex, e-channels, OTP, and the Cisco IVR/ACD and speech-recording stack. Specify APIs, real-time context retrieval, latency targets, and the model-hosting approach. Advise on model selection (LLM/SLM and routing), RAG, hallucination mitigation, confidence thresholds, and prompt/version management. Establish AI governance and guardrail frameworks aligned to SAMA and PDPL regulations, covering human-in-the-loop for sensitive flows, audit trails, data residency, and PII redaction. Collaborate with Compliance, Risk, Legal, and Information Security teams to secure necessary approvals. Manage System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and phased go-live processes, including risk, issue, and dependency management. Set up analytics/AI-ops monitoring and reporting, and manage post-go-live operations. Coach and up-skill a nominated internal candidate (prospective AI-Ops Lead) and the wider team, producing runbooks and operational handover documentation. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in product management, technical leadership, or a similar role within AI, contact center technologies, or related fields. Demonstrated experience in managing complex technical projects from conception to delivery. Proficiency in AI governance, compliance, and data security principles. Required Skills Strong technical acumen in AI/ML, conversational AI, and contact center solutions. Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications. Experience with vendor management and technical evaluation processes. Knowledge of core banking systems (T24), CRM (MS Dynamics), and IVR/ACD stacks (Cisco). Excellent communication and leadership skills for team development and stakeholder engagement. Work Type This is a full-time position.

701791910de9312a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أسلاك البكرية الصناعية عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع، بالإضافة إلى متابعة التحصيلات وإعداد التقارير الدورية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات) لضمان فهم شامل للعروض. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، مع تضمين بيانات الاتصال والعناوين. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المخولة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور العمل الميداني والتواصل المباشر مع العملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

7073625ca0b02e57.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director - Worker Welfare (RD 4) to lead the Worker Welfare function for City Operations. This full-time role focuses on occupational health, workplace safety, ergonomics, and the overall quality of the working environment. The Director will establish governance, assurance, and monitoring frameworks to protect worker wellbeing, identify workplace risks, and ensure fair, safe, and healthy working conditions across City Operations and its service-provider activities. Core Responsibilities Lead the City Operations Worker Welfare function and translate corporate requirements into practical standards, plans, and controls. Establish a worker welfare governance, assurance, and monitoring framework covering occupational health, workplace safety, ergonomics, welfare facilities, and working-environment conditions. Develop risk-based inspection and review programs for City Operations workplaces and service-provider operations. Monitor worker welfare performance, trends, concerns, and corrective actions, escalating material issues to leadership. Coordinate with Health & Safety, FLS, Human Capital, Procurement, Operations, Asset Management, and service providers to embed worker welfare requirements into operational delivery. Support the assessment and improvement of workplace ergonomics, job design, welfare facilities, and environmental conditions affecting worker health and wellbeing. Oversee investigation and follow-up of worker welfare concerns, non-compliances, and recurring workplace issues. Ensure worker welfare requirements are incorporated into contractor scopes, mobilization, performance monitoring, and service reviews. Build awareness and capability through guidance, training, and engagement with employees and service providers. Specific Duties Develop and maintain the City Operations Worker Welfare Plan, procedures, checklists, and reporting arrangements. Maintain a worker welfare risk and action register with accountable owners and closure evidence. Coordinate occupational health and ergonomic assessments where required and track recommended improvements. Conduct or coordinate worker interviews, workplace observations, and welfare-facility reviews as part of assurance activities. Produce periodic dashboards and management reports covering leading indicators, findings, trends, and overdue actions. Support continual improvement of working conditions across City Operations. General Responsibilities Contribute to annual business planning, workforce planning, and budget management for the function. Lead, coach, and develop assigned teams and specialist service providers. Promote a culture of accountability, prevention, continual improvement, and evidence-based decision-making. Maintain accurate records and provide timely reports, presentations, and recommendations to City Operations leadership. Perform other related duties consistent with the role and business requirements. Internal and External Interactions The Director will engage with various internal and external stakeholders to fulfill the role's objectives. Key Internal Interactions include: City Operations leadership and functional directors Health & Safety, FLS, and Environmental teams Human Capital and Employee Relations Contracts & Procurement Operations, Asset Management, and Community Management Governance, Risk & Controls Communications and relevant project/handover teams Key External Interactions include: Relevant government and regulatory authorities Occupational health and ergonomics specialists Operations, maintenance, and service-provider contractors Worker welfare auditors and consultants Healthcare and employee-assistance providers, as applicable Developers and delivery partners

70b454cd98dacadb.description: About the Role KBR Saudi Arabia is seeking a Risk Manager to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role reports to the Project Controls Director and is responsible for delivering portfolio-wide risk management services. The position supports effective governance, decision-making, and assurance across a major infrastructure program in Riyadh, which is envisioned as a global landmark mixed-use development. Role Purpose and Context The Risk Manager ensures that all risk management activities align with approved risk policies, frameworks, and systems. This involves overseeing the risk management practices of various Project Management Consultants (PMCs) and providing strategic support to the overall development program. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and administer the approved Risk Management Plan (RMP), including associated procedures, processes, and templates. Review and supervise Risk Management Plans and risk registers of PMCs to ensure alignment with the overarching RMP. Support the implementation and effective use of risk management systems. Provide guidance and training to PMCs to ensure consistent and effective application of risk management practices. Facilitate risk meetings and develop Risk Registers for Delivery Programmes and client departments. Facilitate mitigation strategies for risks and issues through consolidation of risk registers, meetings, and workshops. Consolidate PMC risk registers into programme-level and departmental risk registers for escalation and reporting. Maintain updated Dashboards for risks and issues across the entire Development Portfolio. Conduct monthly risk management quality assurance reviews and status updates. Escalate unresolved complaints and urgent matters to the relevant supervisor. Maintain an organized and presentable reception area. Prepare shift handover notes and communicate pending requests to the next shift. Handle residents' personal information and inquiries with confidentiality. Perform other related duties as assigned. Customer-oriented attitude with the ability to handle complaints professionally.

70edcad349ea1b2f.job_title: Senior Telco OSS Application Support Engineer (L2 /L3 )
70edcad349ea1b2f.description: About the Role Ericsson KSA is seeking a Charging Support Engineer to join the EMEA Networks team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on supporting key Communication Service Provider (CSP) customers. The engineer will contribute to securing service availability and performance, resolving complex incidents, and maintaining network stability and customer satisfaction within the EMEA Service Line Support & Repair. Role Context and Collaboration The Charging Support Engineer will work with customer operations, Ericsson Global and Market Area support teams, and Product Development Units. This collaboration extends across various charging and connected systems, including IN/SDP, online/offline charging, mediation, and core and billing/CRM interfaces. The role is integral to fulfilling Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and ensuring customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Support Ericsson Charging in live customer networks, resolving incidents, problems, and service requests within agreed SLAs, including root-cause analysis and documentation. Analyze logs, protocols, signaling, transactions, and call flows across charging nodes and connected systems to identify failures and isolate faults. Execute workarounds, configuration changes, and corrective actions in accordance with Ericsson processes and customer change management. Perform health checks, monitoring, and performance analysis; identify risks and recurring issues, and drive preventive actions for stability and customer experience. Maintain problem records and knowledge-base articles; participate in major-incident Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and follow through on corrective and preventive actions. Support software updates, patches, and hot fixes through impact checks, test/pre-production validation, implementation support, and post-change follow-up. Collaborate with Global Support, Market Area teams, and Product Development Units on complex tickets, escalations, and product defects. Analyze capacity, performance, and stability; recommend improvements and present incident trends, risks, and service actions in customer reviews. Contribute to continuous improvement, automation, and best-practice sharing initiatives. 7077a90236ef5252.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة راية العلم الأهلية عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على تنفيذها وتقييمها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد أسباب نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات تسعير تنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج واختيار قنوات التوزيع وتقييم فعالية الحملات الإعلانية والدعائية. وضع جداول زمنية لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات السوق للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها النهائي، باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة حسب متطلبات العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم دورة حياة المنتج وأسعار المنافسين. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الطائف، مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بدوام كامل. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تحقيق الأهداف التسويقية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

70c3c209edf5b258.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسوار البنا للصيانة والنظافة عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في عنيزة، القصيم. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع جوانب عمليات الصيانة، بما في ذلك تخطيط العمل وتوزيع المهام وتطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة لعمليات الصيانة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الصيانة أو دور مشابه. القدرة على إعداد خطط وبرامج العمل. مهارات جيدة في متابعة وتقييم الأداء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وتخطيطية ممتازة. القدرة على قيادة وتوجيه فريق العمل. مهارات تواصل فعالة. القدرة على تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية وتصميم البرامج المناسبة. الدقة في توثيق وحفظ التقارير والنتائج. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الصيانة في شركة اسوار البنا للصيانة والنظافة، ومقرها في عنيزة، القصيم. ستعمل ضمن بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التنسيق المستمر مع أعضاء الفريق والإدارة لضمان سير عمليات الصيانة بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

70c604e71f1f50cb.description: Job Summary: PayLink is seeking a Risk Manager to lead its Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) function as an independent control function. You will develop and maintain the risk management framework, assess risks across the business, and provide clear insights that support informed decisions, business resilience, and compliance with applicable Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) requirements. The role works closely with senior management, relevant committees, and departmental risk owners while maintaining independent oversight and clear accountability. Key Responsibilities: 1. Governance, Strategy and Risk Management Framework Develop and update the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, policies, methodologies, tools and templates, and submit them for approval under the delegation of authority. Prepare an annual risk management strategy and work plan aligned with the Company’s strategy, license category and scale of operations. Define roles, responsibilities, escalation lines, risk owners and control owners in coordination with relevant departments, without imposing unapproved operational authority. Support the Risk Committee and relevant committees by preparing materials and reports and tracking decisions within each committee’s mandate. Review the framework periodically following product, business model or regulatory changes or material events. 2. Risk Identification, Assessment and Risk Register Lead enterprise assessments of inherent and residual risk in collaboration with departmental risk owners. Establish and maintain the enterprise risk register, documenting causes, impacts, controls, assessments, treatment owners and target dates. Coordinate Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) and challenge the reasonableness of assessments against available evidence. Assess enterprise risks arising from new products and services, material changes, projects, expansion and partnerships before recommendations are submitted. Conduct scenario analyses and stress testing in line with priorities, capabilities and available data, in coordination with Finance, Operations and Technology. 3. Risk Appetite, Indicators and Reporting Develop and review the risk appetite statement and tolerance limits in coordination with Finance, Compliance, Operations, Cybersecurity and other stakeholders, and submit them to the authorized approving body. Develop a proportionate set of Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), defining data sources, data owners, measurement frequency and alert thresholds. Monitor risk appetite breaches, analyze their causes, recommend mitigation and escalate under approved authorities. Produce concise periodic reports for senior management and relevant committees on material risks, trends, breaches, remediation plans and decisions required. 4. Control Assessment and Independent Challenge Assess control design adequacy and effectiveness from a risk management perspective, using supporting evidence, test results, reports, interviews and appropriate samples. Request information and evidence necessary for risk assessments within approved access rights, need-to-know principles, confidentiality and data protection requirements. Document professional disagreements with risk or control owners and escalate material matters through approved channels. Do not operate controls, make specialist operational decisions or substitute for Internal Audit’s independent assurance role. 5. Financial, Operational, Technology and Financial Crime Risks Monitor risks relating to liquidity, settlements, partner banks, fraud, operations, third parties, concentration, reputation and strategy in coordination with their respective owners. Assess cybersecurity and technology risks within the enterprise framework in coordination with Cybersecurity and Technology, without assuming their specialist or operational responsibilities. Include money laundering, terrorist financing and proliferation financing risks in the enterprise risk register and independently challenge exposures, controls and residual risk in coordination with Compliance and the AML officer. Access appropriate transaction, alert and suspicion-related indicators for risk assessment, subject to confidentiality restrictions on reports and protected case files; this role does not include investigating individual cases or making regulatory reporting decisions. Ensure enterprise assessments align with specialist risk assessments without creating conflicting assessments or transferring ownership of specialist programs to Risk Management. 6. Business Continuity and Crisis Management Oversee the Business Continuity Management (BCM) framework and program through the Business Continuity Officer and relevant functions, monitoring plans, testing and remediation readiness. Review Business Impact Analysis (BIA) results, verify business owners’ validation of impacts and dependencies, and confirm that Technology and Operations have assessed recovery target feasibility. Monitor business continuity, disaster recovery and crisis management plans and tests, while operational response and recovery remain with designated teams. Report material readiness gaps to senior management and relevant committees, coordinating with Compliance on regulatory notifications. 7. Third Parties, Changes and Projects Assess risks relating to suppliers, outsourcing, third-party dependencies, concentration and single points of failure in collaboration with relationship owners. Review risks associated with projects, material changes and new services and provide recommendations before approval. Track risk mitigation plans, action owners and deadlines without executing other departments’ remedial actions. 8. Regulatory Requirements, Coordination and Awareness Monitor regulatory requirements applicable to the risk management function and compile supporting evidence with Compliance and relevant stakeholders. Participate in supervisory visits and respond on enterprise risk management topics using validated information, referring specialist technical topics to their owners. Track regulatory and Internal Audit findings relevant to Risk Management and verify remediation by responsible owners. Deliver practical risk awareness and training to risk owners and promote risk culture throughout the Company. Maintain orderly records of evidence, assessments, reports, decisions and relevant correspondence. Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is preferred. Preferably at least seven years of relevant experience in risk management, governance, or financial services, including leadership experience, subject to applicable fit-and-proper requirements. Practical experience within financial institutions or payment service providers supervised by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA). Working knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), risk appetite, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), Business Continuity Management (BCM), internal controls, and regulatory reporting. Relevant professional credentials, such as FRM, CRMP, RIMS-CRMP, or an ISO 31000-related qualification, are preferred and complement practical experience. Strong analytical judgment and independent assessment skills, with the ability to connect risk exposures to business objectives and regulatory impact. Effective communication, cross-functional coordination, and professional conflict management skills. Ability to prepare clear executive reports and provide practical, actionable recommendations. Strong planning and prioritization skills, including tracking remediation activities within available resources. Ability to evaluate evidence and data while maintaining the confidentiality of sensitive information. Leadership and coaching skills, with the ability to strengthen risk culture and influence stakeholders without direct line authority.

702f944368bda8aa.description: About the Role ALPLA Group is seeking a Purchasing Administrator to join our team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is essential for managing procurement processes, ensuring timely acquisition of materials and services, and maintaining strong supplier relationships. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience in a purchasing or administrative capacity. Key Responsibilities Coordinate with planning and functional departments to ensure timely requests for necessary items. Prioritize and issue all purchase orders (POs) without delay. Negotiate prices and submit price comparisons to Operations Managers (OMs) for approval. Source various materials and services. Maintain up-to-date supplier records and purchasing databases. Track all POs and provide regular updates to OMs. Implement a system to track goods and services POs to ensure on-time delivery. Identify and report potential risks such as price increases or material shortages due to supplier issues. Update the price matrix on a monthly basis. Ensure a minimum of three suppliers for each item. Maintain accurate records of all purchasing processes. Verify that all purchase orders comply with company policy. Reduce discrepancies between the Purchase Requisition (PSR), Purchase Order (PO), and Goods Receipt (RIR) processes. Order materials and services based on negotiated and approved quotations. Review quotations and report any discrepancies. Maintain current procurement files. Manage petty cash and reconcile reports promptly. Handle all types of purchase orders, including forging and local purchases. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a purchasing or administrative role. Demonstrated ability to negotiate prices and manage supplier relationships. Proficiency in maintaining accurate records and databases. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to work effectively with various departments. Work Environment and Benefits Working with ALPLA Group offers a modern and family-oriented work environment. The Purchasing Administrator will be integrated into a dynamic team, undertaking challenging tasks with a high degree of self-responsibility. Individual performance is recognized and supported for further development.

70c0d6113583ec50.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مدارس الأوس الأهلية في المدينة المنورة عن سكرتير بدوام كامل للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري للمدير أو الإدارة، والمساهمة في تنسيق المشاريع الأساسية وإدارة جدول الأعمال اليومي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدوين الملاحظات المكتوبة بطريقة الاختزال (الكتابة السريعة)، ونسخ المراسلات والتقارير ومحاضر الاجتماعات، ومراجعتها وتنسيقها وفقاً لمعايير المكتب. تلقي المكالمات الهاتفية من الموظفين والعملاء الخارجيين وفرزها وتوجيهها، واستلام الرسائل الهاتفية، والإجابة على استفسارات المتصلين، وتحويل المكالمات إلى الشخص المناسب. التعامل مع البريد الوارد والصادر، بما في ذلك فحص المراسلات البريدية وتسجيلها وتوزيعها. فحص طلبات الاجتماعات والمواعيد، وتنسيق جداول المشاركين، وتحديد أوقات الاجتماعات، وتأمين قاعة الاجتماعات، وتحضير جدول الأعمال. إنشاء أنظمة لحفظ الملفات والسجلات وصيانتها، وضمان حفظ جميع المستندات بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال السكرتارية أو الدعم الإداري. القدرة على كتابة الوثائق وإدارة المكالمات الهاتفية والزوار بفعالية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة وقدرة على إدارة المهام المتعددة. المهارات والكفاءات إتقان مهارات الكتابة السريعة (الاختزال) ونسخ المراسلات. مهارات تواصل قوية شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على استخدام برامج الحاسوب المكتبية الأساسية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد الوثائق وتنظيم الملفات. بيئة العمل يعمل السكرتير في بيئة تعليمية داعمة ضمن مدارس الأوس الأهلية في المدينة المنورة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتقدم فرصة للمساهمة في بيئة عمل منظمة ومحترفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

70dfb0e3289f9b25.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تركيب ومراقبة وصيانة المكونات الكهربائية الأساسية، وتقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها. تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في تشخيص وحل المشكلات الفنية. تحديد المخطط، وتقدير كمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين فيما يتعلق بأعمال التركيب الكهربائي. اختبار النظم بعد تركيبها لضمان التقيد بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. مهام الصيانة والتشخيص القيام بعمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة. تشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو الصيانة الكهربائية. فهم جيد للمخططات الكهربائية والمواصفات الفنية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وإصلاحها بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص، مما يتطلب مهارات تواصل وتعاون جيدة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه في الوقت الحالي. للمهتمين، يرجى تقديم طلبات التوظيف عبر القنوات المتاحة.

701467531e1ca242.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking a Mechatronics & Automation Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves designing, developing, integrating, and validating advanced mechatronic, robotic, and automated systems, including construction automation solutions, within a multidisciplinary R&D environment. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on delivering innovative, reliable, and cost-effective solutions throughout the development lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Translate operational requirements into technical specifications and system architectures, integrating mechanical, electrical, electronic, embedded, control, and software subsystems. Conduct engineering calculations, feasibility studies, design reviews, and risk assessments to optimize performance, reliability, safety, manufacturability, and cost. Develop mechanical concepts, mechanisms, assemblies, and structural interfaces, preparing 3D models, 2D manufacturing drawings, and Bills of Materials (BOMs). Design electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, control-panel layouts, and system interfaces, including calculating electrical loads and selecting components. Develop and troubleshoot PLC programs, control sequences, interlocks, and alarms. Program, configure, calibrate, and integrate industrial and collaborative robots, developing motion paths and sensor-based operations. Integrate embedded firmware, electronic circuits, hardware interfaces, and PCB systems. Select and calibrate sensors, instrumentation, and feedback systems, integrating HMI/GUI applications, APIs, data logging, diagnostics, and automated controls. Prepare technical specifications for suppliers, evaluate components and quotations, and coordinate with procurement to resolve technical issues. Assemble, configure, test, and commission prototypes and automated systems, executing test plans to verify functionality, accuracy, performance, reliability, and safety. Maintain engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, test records, and BOMs, preparing operating instructions and maintenance procedures. General Accountabilities Continuously enhance technical knowledge, engineering competencies, and professional skills through training and knowledge-sharing activities. Complete assigned tasks within agreed schedules, budgets, and quality requirements, utilizing resources efficiently and reporting deviations. Take ownership of assigned tasks, proactively address technical and operational challenges, and escalate risks affecting safety, quality, cost, or project delivery. Ensure compliance with approved specifications, procedures, and quality standards, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including engineering, project management, procurement, production, quality, and operations. Comply with company policies, document-control procedures, confidentiality requirements, and intellectual property protection. Apply applicable Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) requirements during design, assembly, testing, and commissioning, identifying and reporting hazards. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in mechatronics and automation engineering. Demonstrated ability to combine mechanical, electrical, electronic, embedded systems, control systems, and software engineering principles. Experience in the full development lifecycle, from requirements definition to commissioning and continuous improvement. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, operating within a multidisciplinary R&D environment focused on innovative solutions.

702a2d216224c28c.job_title: Senior Associate Consultant SAP Employee Portal
702a2d216224c28c.description: About the Role Invenio is seeking an Associate Consultant SAP Enterprise Portal to join its team. This full-time role is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on supporting portal development and administration activities. The position involves assisting in configuring portal components and learning SAP EP concepts, working collaboratively to deliver basic portal solutions. Key Responsibilities Assist in the development and maintenance of portal applications. Support the configuration of iViews, pages, and roles within the portal. Aid in portal testing and issue resolution processes. Monitor portal activities and report any identified issues. Maintain documentation and learn to utilize EP tools effectively. Business Acumen Demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills, ensuring clear and concise interactions. Understand business processes relevant to focus areas or modules. Possess the ability to conduct research and perform detailed tasks. Exhibit strong analytical skills. Understand business functionality related to SAP modules/applications and identify touch points between modules. Be capable of solving detailed SAP problems. Understand and explain best business practices, particularly those enabled by SAP. Consulting and General Skills Show aptitude for working in a team environment, including problem-solving, creative thinking, empathetic communication, strong time management, and collaboration with all staff levels. Learn and understand consulting "soft" skills necessary for client engagements and team initiatives. Interpret requirements and apply SAP best practices. Possess strong presentation skills. Understand the client’s business and technical environment. Assist project teams in documenting and developing solutions for client situations. Support team efforts in preparing and developing solution documentation for projects. Learn to understand and adhere to project and organization guidelines, managing administrative responsibilities timely and effectively. Keep the manager informed of workload direction and concerns. Learn to analyze and develop reliable solutions that produce efficient and effective outcomes. Develop a deeper understanding of SAP methodologies, tools, standards, and techniques. Assist with project documentation and demonstrate effective organizational skills with minimal supervision. Provide project team and leaders with updates on progress and difficulties, offering value-added insight for future program development. Demonstrate the ability to accomplish project assignments, resulting in quality service. Experience and Work Type This role requires 0-1 years of relevant experience and is a full-time position. The salary for this role will be discussed during the interview process. Application Process Candidates interested in this opportunity are encouraged to apply.

705272e6db82d321.description: نبحث عن مصمم جرافيك مبدع للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تطوير هويتنا البصرية. ستكون مسؤولاً عن إنشاء تصاميم جذابة للمواد التسويقية والإعلانية الرقمية والمطبوعة. إذا كنت شغوفًا بالتصميم ولديك سجل حافل بالإبداع، ندعوك للتقديم. المهام والمسؤوليات: * تصميم الشعارات، الهويات البصرية، والمواد التسويقية المختلفة. * إنشاء تصاميم جذابة لمنصات التواصل الاجتماعي والحملات الإعلانية. * التعاون مع فريق التسويق لتنفيذ الأفكار الإبداعية وتحقيق الأهداف. * العمل على تحسين وتطوير التصاميم الحالية.

709fa89edbd89603.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our team for an upcoming full-time opportunity in Saudi Arabia. This role focuses on mechanical engineering expertise, particularly within Shutdown / Turnaround (SD/TA) projects. The position is based in the Eastern Region, covering cities such as Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Al Jubail, Al-Ahsa, Al Qatif, Buqayq, and Ras Tannurah. Key Responsibilities Lead and execute mechanical maintenance activities during Shutdown / Turnaround projects. Oversee the planning, execution, and coordination of shutdown activities. Manage and maintain various mechanical static equipment, including heat exchangers, columns, pressure vessels, reactors, and pipelines. Utilize Primavera P6 for project scheduling and management. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering. Minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in Mechanical Maintenance or Shutdown / Turnaround projects. Mandatory experience in Shutdown / Turnaround (SD/TA) projects, preferably gained with a contractor. Strong experience with mechanical static equipment, specifically: Heat Exchangers Columns Pressure Vessels Reactors Pipelines Proficiency in Primavera P6 is required. Good English communication skills are essential. Application Requirements Candidates must clearly detail their relevant experience in their CV, supported by verifiable experience certificates or letters. Only applicants with genuine and verifiable Shutdown / Turnaround experience will be considered for this position. Compensation The salary for this full-time role ranges from SAR 4,000 to SAR 7,000 Basic, plus FAT.

70ca4bcf8f198022.description: About the Role كيلوج براون اند روت is seeking a Rotating Technician (Level II) to join its Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) team. This full-time role involves contributing to the delivery of holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle, including licensed process technologies, advisory services, technical expertise, and smart solutions for optimizing assets. Key Responsibilities Allocate maintenance activities to technicians and assemble teams. Supervise ongoing jobs and provide progress updates to the Foreman. Organize manpower resources, equipment, and material availability. Arrange necessary work permits prior to the commencement of work. Provide technical advice to technicians on the proper use of tools and equipment. Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance Planning, and Technical departments to execute and complete jobs. Ensure the maintenance of SAP data input, history, and actual hours. Attend daily and weekly maintenance progress meetings. Maintain strict compliance with SATORP standards and guidelines. Conduct Toolbox talks before commencing work. Ensure compliance with safe work practices, hazardous work regulations, and PPE usage according to SATORP standards. Encourage the reporting of near misses, unsafe conditions, and acts. Participate in Safety audits. Attend scheduled Safety and Technical training. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 6 years of experience in Oil & Gas maintenance with a High School diploma. Minimum of 4 years of experience in Oil & Gas maintenance with a Diploma. Hold a valid certification issued by a recognized third-party certification body or an accredited Saudi institute, attesting to qualifications and competency for the work. Required Skills and Attributes Strong technical understanding of maintenance management in Oil & Gas Facilities. Well-organized and proactive with excellent communication skills. Proven leadership skills within large organizations. Maturity of judgment under pressure and the ability to resolve problems effectively. Ability to achieve business results while working in a multi-cultural environment.

7042bbde833abce1.description: About the Role Salam is seeking a Manager Business Billing Collection and Assurance to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing and optimizing billing, collection, and assurance processes for business operations, ensuring compliance and customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Manage overdue payments and follow up with customers to collect outstanding debts in a timely manner. Create and monitor invoice payment progress within the Etimad portal. Evaluate and ensure compliance with government regulations and policies related to billing, invoicing, and payment collection. Implement strategies to improve the timely processing of payments. Reconcile accounts to ensure payments received match billed amounts and resolve any discrepancies. Monitor and support customers regarding billing inquiries, payment options, and other related queries or concerns professionally. Build and maintain positive relationships with government customers to ensure satisfaction and facilitate smooth payment processes. Analyze payment trends, customer behavior, and debt patterns to identify opportunities for process improvements and revenue optimization. Monitor key performance indicators related to billing, collections, and customer satisfaction to track departmental performance and identify areas for improvement. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this position should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in business billing, collections, and assurance. A strong understanding of financial regulations and customer relationship management is essential for success in this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to Salam's business operations within a structured and professional environment.

70914db7e68e1ff4.description: About the Role Bank of Jordan - KSA Branch is seeking a Corporate Sales & Services Officer to join its Corporate Banking team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing high-quality banking services to corporate clients, supporting their banking needs, and strengthening client relationships. The successful candidate will also be responsible for promoting the Bank's products and services. Key Responsibilities Provide day-to-day banking services and support to corporate clients. Handle customer inquiries and ensure timely resolution of service requests. Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate customers. Promote the Bank's products and services and identify business opportunities. Support account opening, account maintenance, and customer documentation processes. Process corporate banking requests, including transfers, salary files, and banking instructions. Coordinate with internal departments to ensure efficient service delivery. Encourage clients to utilize the Bank's digital banking channels. Conduct client visits when required. Ensure compliance with the Bank's policies and procedures. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Banking, or a related field. Minimum of 3 years of experience in banking, with a preference for Corporate Banking or Corporate Customer Service. Good knowledge of corporate banking products and services. Required Skills Strong communication and relationship management skills. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities effectively. Good command of English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Work Environment This is a full-time position within the Corporate Banking team at Bank of Jordan's KSA Branch in Riyadh. The role requires interaction with corporate clients and internal departments to ensure efficient service delivery.

709bdf8ad3c430b2.job_title: Credit Control Consultant Al Futtaim Automotive Finance
709bdf8ad3c430b2.description: About the Role As a Credit Control Consultant at مجموعة الفطيم - غير ذلك in Riyadh, you will be responsible for managing credit deals and monitoring accounts receivables across various brand portfolios. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and is central to maintaining the financial health and operational efficiency of Famco KSA. Key Responsibilities Verify supporting documents for validity and correctness. Prepare credit assessment reports and submit them for approval. Ensure credit approval is completed as per DOA and within SLA timeframes. Update credit approval terms in SAP Customer Credit master and maintain the credit approval tracker. Monitor customer account details for non-payments, delayed payments, and other irregularities. Follow up with Business Finance and Sales teams to resolve collection issues. Ensure timely accounting of payments received from customers. Monitor unallocated credits and coordinate necessary adjustments with FSSC O2C/Business Finance. Develop AR reports and communicate collection issues to senior management. Conduct periodic credit reviews of accounts and coordinate with the Head of Corporate Credit and Business Heads to maintain adequate credit limits. Revise payment terms as necessary and conduct field visits to clients when needed. Prepare monthly reports within three working days post month-close and timely report delinquent account status. Ensure 95% of credit assessments are completed within the approved SLA. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field. Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in Credit as a credit analyst, with underwriting (credit application) experience. Proficiency in both Arabic and English, including reading and writing. Competency with ERP systems such as SAP.

70e6ccf0a6cc3ac2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المصباح للاتصالات عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال المبيعات. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد مشكلاتهم واحتياجاتهم. متابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية المحتملة. تقييم أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. عرض وتوضيح وحفظ التقارير في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الفرص. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتفاعل مع العملاء والزملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتقديم التوصيات بشكل احترافي. بيئة العمل والمزايا يعمل أخصائي المبيعات ضمن فريق في مدينة جدة بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتوفر راتباً شهرياً قدره 4100 ريال سعودي، بالإضافة إلى عمولات وحوافز شهرية بناءً على الأداء. معلومات إضافية هذه الفرصة مناسبة للمرشحين الذين يتمتعون بالقدرة على تحليل السوق وتطوير استراتيجيات البيع، والذين يسعون لتطبيق مهاراتهم في بيئة عمل ديناميكية ومحفزة.

700828f1af1fab21.description: About Roche Roche is seeking a Supply Chain Lead, Public Sector to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. The role serves as a primary operational liaison, driving end-to-end customer fulfillment and streamlining processes within the public sector supply chain. The Role The Supply Chain Lead for the Public Sector will act as the main operational point of contact between Roche Diagnostics Saudi Arabia, NUPCO, the Ministry of Health (MOH), and third-party logistics (3PL) providers. This position is responsible for ensuring efficient customer fulfillment, optimizing order-to-cash (O2C) processes, and fostering strong, direct relationships with key public stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Serve as the primary point of contact for NUPCO and MOH supply chain operations and warehouses. Establish and maintain regular operational review meetings with the NUPCO Supply Chain team to ensure alignment on tender fulfillment and delivery schedules. Represent Roche Diagnostics Saudi Arabia in operational forums, proactively resolving fulfillment bottlenecks and delivery disputes. Act as the primary Supply Chain partner for the tender business, collaborating closely with the Head of Sales MOH while maintaining clear functional accountability within the Supply Chain organization. Establish and lead a regular Tender Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and governance process with MOH Sales, covering tender pipeline visibility, demand assumptions, supply feasibility, inventory readiness, execution risks, and customer commitments. Ensure joint Supply Chain–Commercial decision-making through transparent KPIs, documented assumptions, agreed actions, and clear escalation mechanisms. Unresolved cross-functional priorities will be escalated jointly to the Head of Supply Chain and Head of Sales MOH. Oversee the end-to-end order lifecycle for NUPCO / MOH tenders / purchase orders, ensuring accurate and timely fulfillment. Track and expedite the issuance of Goods Received Notes (GRNs) from NUPCO/MOH stores and MOH labs. Manage portal operations, including NUPCO platforms. Coordinate with local 3PL providers to ensure On-Time, In-Full (OTIF) deliveries across NUPCO warehouses and to end customers. Monitor delivery windows and batch documentation to prevent penalties and liquidated damages. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in supply chain management, particularly within the public sector or with government entities. A strong understanding of tender processes, logistics, and stakeholder management is essential. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and involves working closely with internal teams at Roche Diagnostics Saudi Arabia, as well as external partners such as NUPCO, the Ministry of Health, and 3PL providers. Application Process If you meet the qualifications and are interested in this opportunity, please submit your application. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

70bb3f8295c92dc4.description: نعلن لجميع طالب الوظايف عن حاجة الشركة في تعيين اخصائي تسويق سعودي الجنسيه يفضل يكون من ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصه

70bdc5ed79a3a6c5.description: About the Role TRS Staffing Solutions is seeking an experienced Proposal Manager for a contract position in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia. This role involves leading the preparation of various submission documents for EPC, EPCM, and PMC projects, including Statements of Interest (SOIs), Requests for Quotation (RFQs), Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and Invitations to Bid (ITBs). 704fa08d7d41db79.description: About the Role Bechtel Corporation is seeking a Risk Lead to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the project-level risk and issue management cycle and supporting the Risk Manager in maintaining an integrated, decision-focused risk management framework. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Project Context: Expo 2030 Riyadh The Expo 2030 Riyadh project is a global platform focused on sustainable development, innovation, and transformative thinking, scheduled from October 2030 to March 2031, expecting over 40 million visits. Bechtel will manage the infrastructure program for the six-square-kilometer Masterplan, which includes early works, utilities, and publicly accessible spaces. This scope will transition into a mixed-use legacy development post-event, leveraging international sustainability standards. Key Responsibilities Lead and facilitate project risk and opportunity reviews and issue review sessions with various stakeholders including PMC, ERC, Project Controls, Planning, Commercial, Engineering, Procurement, and Construction teams. Maintain the completeness and quality of project risk and issue registers in Active Risk Manager (ARM), ensuring clear cause-event-effect statements, ownership, scoring, response strategies, due dates, escalation status, and supporting evidence. Challenge risk owners and action owners on the adequacy, practicality, and expected effectiveness of mitigation and recovery actions. Monitor overdue and ageing actions, follow up with accountable owners, identify barriers to completion, and escalate material delays or ineffective responses to the Risk Manager. Confirm that proposed action closures are supported by evidence and that residual exposure has been reassessed before recommending closure. Identify cross-project and programme-level risks and support their consolidation, escalation, and de-escalation. Develop, validate, run, and maintain Quantitative Schedule Risk Analysis (QSRA) models in Safran Risk for individual projects and consolidated programme analysis. Work with Planning and Project Controls teams to confirm that schedules used for QSRA are logically sound, appropriately status, and suitable for probabilistic analysis. Interpret QSRA outputs, including key drivers, criticality, probability distributions, and confidence dates, and prepare clear management-level conclusions and recommendations. Support the Risk Manager in implementing the risk management plan, governance, escalation criteria, assurance checks, workshops, and continuous improvement activities. Provide timely, quality-assured risk, issue, action, escalation, and QSRA inputs to the Risk Analyst for recurring and ad hoc client reporting. Coach the Risk Analyst and project stakeholders on risk data quality, reporting requirements, ARM usage, and consistent application of the approved risk process. Key Deliverables Updated project risk, opportunity, issue, and action records following each review cycle. Action ageing and effectiveness analysis, including overdue-action escalation recommendations. Project and programme QSRA models, assumptions logs, model validation records, sensitivity outputs, and management summaries. Consolidated project-to-programme risk inputs, emerging-risk themes, and escalation recommendations. Quality-assured source data and commentary for weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting. Working Interfaces and Performance Expectations The Risk Lead will interface with the Risk Manager, programme/project leadership teams, PMC and ERC project teams, risk owners, issue owners, action owners, and various functional teams including Project Controls, Planning, Cost, Commercial, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, HSE, Quality, and stakeholder management. Collaboration with the Risk Analyst for reporting, dashboard, data-quality, and client-submission inputs is also essential. Performance expectations include ensuring risk and issue information is current, evidence-based, and suitable for project and programme decision-making. Actions must be specific, owned, time-bound, monitored, and challenged for effectiveness before closure. Required reports and analysis are to be delivered accurately and in accordance with the agreed reporting calendar, with stakeholder engagement being proactive, professional, and focused on resolving risk and issue exposure.

7084669d74e5a55c.description: Job Title: Manager, Procurement & Supply Chain (Healthcare Experience Required) Department: Procurement & Supply Chain Management The Manager of Procurement & Supply Chain owns vendor and contract risk for QHC from Day-1 and builds the procurement and supply-chain capability the organization needs as it scales through the startup phase. The role ensures that sourcing, contracting and supplier management are governed, compliant and value-driven. The role establishes the policies, processes and controls that let QHC procure at pace without compromising governance. The role works across clinical, technology, facilities and enabling functions, and coordinates with QIC shared services and third-party providers, to ensure the reliable, cost-effective and compliant supply of medical and non-medical goods and services. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES 1. Procurement Strategy & Planning • Develop and maintain QHC's procurement plan aligned with startup priorities, activation milestones and budget, including category strategies for medical, technology, facilities and professional services. • Forecast demand and lead times and sequence sourcing activity to meet Day-1 and scale-up needs. • Advise leadership on make-versus-buy and leverage-from-QIC decisions across categories. 2. Sourcing, Tendering & Contract Management • Lead sourcing, tendering and competitive evaluation processes with fairness, transparency and auditability. • Negotiate and structure contracts, service agreements and framework arrangements that protect QHC commercially and operationally. • Maintain the contract register, manage renewals and expiries, and ensure obligations are tracked and met. 3. Vendor & Supplier Relationship Management • Establish and manage supplier relationships, onboarding, qualification and performance monitoring against agreed KPIs and SLAs. • Own vendor risk — including concentration, continuity and compliance risk — and drive remediation where performance falls short. • Build a reliable supplier base for critical medical and operational categories. 4. Supply Chain & Inventory Management • Establish supply-chain and inventory processes across medical consumables, pharmaceuticals, equipment and non-medical supplies. • Ensure availability, traceability and appropriate stock levels for clinical and operational continuity, minimizing waste and stock-outs. • Coordinate logistics, warehousing and distribution arrangements as required. 5. Governance, Compliance & Risk • Implement procurement policies, delegation of authority, controls and segregation of duties to mitigate financial and compliance risk. • Ensure compliance with Saudi procurement and regulatory requirements and with QIC service and governance frameworks. • Maintain audit readiness, procurement records and risk registers for internal and external review. 6. Cost Optimization & Value Delivery • Drive cost efficiency, value-for-money and total-cost-of-ownership discipline across procurement decisions. • Identify and deliver savings, consolidation and demand-management opportunities without compromising quality or continuity. • Provide procurement input to budgeting, business cases and capital planning. 7. Systems, Process & Capability • Support the implementation and use of e-procurement and supply-chain systems and dashboards. • Standardize procurement processes and build internal capability as the function grows. • Provide clear procurement reporting and analytics to Finance and leadership. EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field is required. A professional certification (CIPS, CPSM, or equivalent) and / or a Master's degree is preferred. 6+ years of progressive experience in procurement and supply-chain management, including sourcing, tendering, contract negotiation and vendor management, ideally within healthcare, construction / facilities, or large project / startup environments. Demonstrated experience owning vendor and contract risk and establishing procurement processes and controls. Experience with medical / pharmaceutical supply chains and with accredited healthcare environments is an advantage. Working knowledge of Saudi procurement and regulatory requirements and of operating within shared-services or SLA-based models. Strong commercial, negotiation and analytical capability.
